zh: 去年我在另一个城市迷路，一位老人把我送到了车站。
old_en: Last year, while I was in another city, I got lost, and an elderly man was taking me to the station.
new_en: Last year, I got lost in another city and an old man took me to the station.

zh: 去年旅行时我在一个陌生的城市迷路，幸好一位老人带我到车站。
old_en: Last year, when I was traveling in a strange city, I got lost, but a kind elderly person brought me to the station.
new_en: Last year, when I was traveling in a strange city, I got lost, but a kind old man brought me to the station.

zh: 上次在机场我差点误机，还好工作人员帮我改了票。
old_en: Last time at the airport, I was about to miss my flight, but the staff helped me change my ticket.
new_en: Last time at the airport, I almost missed my flight, but the staff helped me change my ticket.

zh: 上次旅行时下雨我没带伞，一家店的店主借给我一把。
old_en: Last time on a trip, it rained, and I didn't have an umbrella, but the shop owner lent me one.
new_en: Last time on a trip, it rained and I didn't have an umbrella, but the shop owner lent me one.

zh: 前年出去玩遇到下雨，我没带伞，店主借了我一把。
old_en: The year before last, when it rained while I was out, I didn't have an umbrella, but the shop owner lent me one.
new_en: The year before last, when it rained while I was out, I didn't have an umbrella, but the shop owner lent me one.

zh: 去年旅行时我把钱包丢了，警察帮我找了回来。
old_en: Last year, while traveling, I lost my wallet, and the police found it for me.
new_en: Last year, while traveling, I lost my wallet, and the police helped me get it back.

zh: 有一次我在外地丢了钱包，后来警察帮我找到了。
old_en: Once, while traveling away from home, I lost my wallet, and later the police found it for me.
new_en: Once, while traveling, I lost my wallet, and the police helped me find it.

zh: 去年住酒店时空调坏了，前台帮我换了一个房间。
old_en: Last year, while staying at a hotel, the air conditioning broke, so the front desk gave me a different room.
new_en: Last year, the air conditioning broke when I was staying at a hotel, so the front desk gave me a different room.

zh: 上次旅行我错过了末班车，后来打车回了酒店。
old_en: Last time I traveled, I missed the last bus, and then I had to take a taxi back to the hotel.
new_en: Last time I traveled, I missed the last bus and had to take a taxi back to the hotel.

zh: 去年在外地错过末班车，最后只好打车回酒店。
old_en: Last year, while traveling away from home, I missed the last bus, and then I could only take a taxi back to the hotel.
new_en: Last year, while traveling, I missed the last bus and had to take a taxi back to the hotel.

zh: 去年旅行时景点突然关门，所以我们去了附近的市场。
old_en: Last year, while we were visiting the attraction, it suddenly closed, so we went to the nearby market instead.
new_en: Last year, the attraction closed suddenly, so we went to a nearby market instead.

zh: 去年我赶飞机迟到了，结果工作人员帮我改签了下一班。
old_en: Last year, while I was rushing to catch my flight, the staff rearranged my booking for the next one.
new_en: Last year, I was late for my flight, so the staff helped me change to the next one.

zh: 上次坐飞机行李被拿错了，结果机场帮我找了回来。
old_en: Last time, while I was sitting on the plane, my luggage was taken by mistake, but the airport helped find it for me.
new_en: Last time, my luggage was mixed up at the airport, but they found it for me.

zh: 去年旅行时行李被别人拿错，还好机场很快找到了。
old_en: Last year, while I was traveling, my luggage was being mixed up by someone, though the airport found it quickly.
new_en: Last year, my luggage was taken by mistake while traveling, but the airport found it quickly.

zh: 去年在国外吃饭时不会说当地话，所以只能用手势点菜。
old_en: Last year, when eating abroad, I wasn't speaking the local language, so I had to use gestures to order.
new_en: Last year, I couldn't speak the local language while eating abroad, so I used gestures to order.

zh: 上次出国旅行语言不通，我用手势点了一顿饭。
old_en: Last time traveling abroad, I was using gestures to order food when I couldn't understand the language.
new_en: Last time traveling abroad, I couldn't speak the language, so I used gestures to order food.

zh: 上次住酒店时房间有问题，所以前台给我换了一间。
old_en: When staying at the hotel last time, the room had a problem, so the front desk gave me a different one.
new_en: Last time, the hotel room had a problem, so the front desk gave me another one.

zh: 上次爬山时我手机没电了，只好向路人求助。
old_en: When I climbed the mountain last time, my phone died, so I had to ask a stranger for help.
new_en: Last time, my phone died while climbing, so I asked a stranger for help.

zh: 去年在山上手机没电，我借路人的电话打给朋友。
old_en: Last year, when my phone ran out of battery on the mountain, I borrowed a stranger's phone to call my friend.
new_en: Last year, my phone died on the mountain, so I used a stranger's phone to call my friend.

zh: 上次去景点发现关门了，我们临时改了行程。
old_en: When we arrived at the attraction last time, it was already closed, so we changed our plans on the spot.
new_en: Last time, the attraction was closed when we got there, so we changed our plans right away.
